description: Diagnose a GitLab pipeline in one call: status, the failed jobs and why GitLab says they failed, and the last script lines of each failed job's trace as evidence. Allowed-to-fail jobs are noted, not counted as the failure. Defaults to the current branch's latest pipeline.

branch.description: Branch whose latest pipeline to read (default: current branch)

cwd.description: Repository path (default: the server's working directory)

mr.description: Merge request IID: read its head pipeline instead

pipeline.description: Pipeline ID (default: the latest pipeline on `branch`)

repo.description: GROUP/REPO or URL (default: the repo at `cwd`)

name: glab_pipeline_failure_summary
title: GitLab pipeline failure summary
